headline: Fronts Reignite Across Contested Sectors
war_summary: The latest returns show the line shifting from a lull to renewed action on several fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the chief furnace, with five base events in two hours and 45 across the day; its present ledger lists two Warden, five Colonial, and two neutral bases, while both casualty streams are accelerating. Palantine Berm has sharply reopened, recording seven events in two hours and 20 in the day, alongside rapidly rising casualties and enlistments. Stonecradle is likewise active, with five recent base events and both sides’ casualty rates accelerating; it now lists one Warden and eight Colonial holdings. Callahan’s Passage has recorded one event in two hours and 35 in 24, with heavy and accelerating losses on both sides across eight Warden and two Colonial bases. Nevish Line has quieted since the previous edition’s immediate flare-up, but six-hour activity and 22 daily events leave its seven Warden, one Colonial arrangement worth watching. Stlican Shelf has also cooled in the latest two-hour window, though 22 daily events and a divided nine-base ledger keep it unsettled.
